system.boundary: Build a closed-loop, multi-domain horizontal-axis wind-turbine model.
engineering_objects: F90-XMECH-02 plant and controller described by the current public task contract
Measured output interfaces: wind_response, pitch_response, hydraulic_effort, yaw_response, drivetrain_response, generation_response
physical_paths: The physical system must contain a grounded tower that supports a yawing nacelle, a finite-inertia three-blade rotor with aerodynamic loads applied to the blades, a connected drivetrain and brake, a generator with an electrical grid path, three hydraulic blade-pitch actuators, and electrically driven geared nacelle-yaw actuation.
The commands and logged outputs must arise from this causal physical system; prescribed output motion, replayed trajectories, or measurements disconnected from the plant are not valid.
Pitch, yaw, braking, and generation changes must act through their modeled actuators and connected mechanical or electrical paths.
functional_paths: Use closed-loop pitch action to regulate the rotor and generator operating condition and to limit aerodynamic loading as wind speed changes.
Supervisory behavior must support generation start, high-wind regulation, and safe reduction or interruption of generation when the operating state requires it.
The internal controller equations and coordinate conventions are not prescribed.
